q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution
The earnings release is scheduled for Wednesday, August 26, 2026. Today is August 22, 2026. This gives us approximately **4 days** until the earnings announcement, at which point NVIDIA will issue forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 (the next quarter after Q2 FY2027 results are reported).

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has already provided explicit Q2 FY2027 guidance in May 2026: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, which equates to a range of $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion.

The question asks about forward guidance to be issued in the Q2 FY2027 earnings release. This guidance would be for **Q3 FY2027** (the quarter following Q2), not Q2 itself.

However, the research indicates:
- Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: $81.6 billion
- Q2 FY2027 guided revenue (issued in May): $91.0B ± 2%
- Wall Street consensus for Q2 FY2027: ~$91.9 billion

The trajectory shows strong sequential growth (Q1 to Q2 was +20% guidance guidance, implying ~$11-12 billion sequential growth from $81.6B).

For forward guidance on Q3 FY2027, we'd expect:
- Continued strong AI demand driving Data Center revenue
- Historical pattern: NVIDIA typically guides to sequential growth, though growth rates may decelerate from the current 85% YoY pace
- Conservative estimate would be 10-15% sequential growth from Q2's ~$91B midpoint, suggesting Q3 guidance in the $100-105B range
- More bullish scenario: 15-20% sequential growth pushing toward $105-110B

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Macro slowdown or AI investment pullback
- Supply chain constraints limiting deliveries
- Competitive pressures from AMD or custom silicon
- China restrictions becoming more severe
- Guidance miss on Q2 results (though current consensus suggests meeting/beating)
- Management taking conservative stance given macro uncertainty

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Better-than-expected Q2 results (above $92.8B guidance)
- Accelerating AI adoption and demand signals
- Higher-than-expected ASP (average selling prices) for H200/Blackwell
- Enterprise data center spending surprises to the upside
- No new China-related headwinds or restrictions

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

No reliable base rate available from the provided research for forward guidance patterns specifically. The research provides the current Q2 FY2027 guidance ($91.0B ± 2%) issued in May, but does not provide historical patterns of how NVIDIA typically adjusts guidance quarter-to-quarter or what sequential growth rates are typical.

---

## Reasoning on the range provided

The question range is **99.5B to 115.5B**, which appears designed for Q3 FY2027 forward guidance (not Q2, which is already guided).

Given:
- Q2 FY2027 guidance midpoint: $91.0B
- Historical sequential growth in this earnings cycle: +20% (Q1 to Q2)
- Typical deceleration of sequential growth rates as revenue bases get larger
- Conservative guidance practice at NVIDIA
- Wall Street consensus would likely model 10-15% sequential growth

**Most likely outcome:** Forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 in the **$100-$105 billion range**, representing ~10-15% sequential growth from Q2's expected ~$91B result.

This would place the median estimate at approximately **102.5 billion**, with reasonable dispersion given the 4-day window and potential for surprises in the actual Q2 results that could shift guidance.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is expected to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after market close [morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/going-into-earnings-is-nvidia-stock-buy-sell-or-fairly-valued-8).

For Q1 FY2027 (ended April 26, 2026), NVIDIA reported record revenue of $81.6 billion, an 85% increase year-over-year and 20% sequentially [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). Data Center revenue was also a record at $75.2 billion, up 92% from a year ago [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/).

NVIDIA's guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, issued in May, is $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). This guidance implies a range between $89.2 billion and $92.8 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). The outlook specifically excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). Wall Street analysts' average estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue is approximately $91.9 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).
